## Not absorbed (not a deletion)

123 upstream files were never taken at F1, before any of the gates above existed.
They are listed apart from the deletions because no functional decision was involved and
no golden transcript vouches for them.

- `models/` -- upstream's `ggml-vocab-*` test vocabularies, 75 MB, read only by `tests/`.
  Also matched by this repo's root `.gitignore` (`*.gguf`), so keeping them would have
  meant files on disk that git silently ignores -- the exact trap F1 existed to remove.
- `.gitignore` files inside the tree -- a nested .gitignore changes what the PARENT
  repository ignores.
